name: Docs
description: Write and revise reports, memos, proposals, PRDs, meeting notes and letters, then export them to Word (.docx), PDF or a self-contained web page. Works offline with a bundled converter; Chinese typography included.
examples: Turn these meeting notes into minutes with decisions and an action table, as a Word file.
Write a two-page proposal for moving our support team to one queue, and give me a PDF.
Tighten this report to half its length without losing the numbers, then export it to Word.

zh-CN.name: 文档
zh-CN.description: 撰写和修改报告、备忘录、方案、需求文档、会议纪要与信函，并导出为 Word（.docx）、PDF 或单个网页文件。自带离线转换器，照顾中文排版。
examples: 把这份会议记录整理成会议纪要，列出决定和待办表格，导出 Word。
写一份两页的方案，建议把客服合并成一个队列，给我 PDF。
把这份报告压缩到一半篇幅、保留所有数字，再导出 Word。
